label: Diagram 18
caption: Diagram 18 Flue outlet positions for solid fuel appliances – clearances to easily ignited roof coverings (Note: This diagram needs to be read in conjunction with Diagram 17)
description: The drawing is a section through a pitched roof, shown as a triangular gable shape with a darker shaded central portion and lighter shaded side portions. The central darker area is labelled A, sitting above a horizontal dashed line near the apex; the two side areas are each labelled B. Dimensions are marked: on the left, a vertical double arrow reads 1800mm; on the right near the top, a vertical arrow reads 600mm; a horizontal double arrow between the inner edges of the side areas reads At least 2300mm; on the far right, a vertical double arrow beside the lower part of the right-hand roof slope reads At least 1800mm. Beneath the left-hand roof slope, text reads Outlets should be above the shaded areas. Beneath the diagram is a table with columns Area and Location of flue outlet. Row A, shaded, states: At least 1800mm vertically above the weather surface and at least 600mm above the ridge. Row B, shaded, states: At least 1800mm vertically above the weather surface and at least 2300mm horizontally from the weather surface.
